headline: Verify the evaluation before trusting the verdict.

observations.note: Model response was rejected before execution; no candidate verdict was inferred.
Admitted candidate passed public validation and the qualified verifier.
Admitted candidate passed four verifier gates under qualified controls.
Public tests passed, but the qualified verifier caught duplicate-processing failures: a genuine false-green.
First bounded repair attempt was rejected at admission because the raw output format was invalid.
Final allowed repair was admitted and public tests passed, but the same qualified verifier gates still failed. Repair budget was exhausted.
The first live model response used v1 and had an unterminated fenced code block, so it was rejected before execution and frozen as HOLD.
A separately versioned v2 initial attempt was admitted, passed public validation, passed all four qualified verifier gates, and preserved the trusted boundary.

demonstrated: Verifier qualification with reference, known-bad, and critical mutation controls.
Public-test false-green detection under a qualified verifier.
Trusted-boundary checks and deterministic evaluation records.
Bounded evidence-guided repair with an explicit attempt budget.
Source-exact no-model replay across historical evaluator versions, including admission HOLD, VERIFIED_PASS, VERIFIED_FAIL, repair HOLD, and terminal repair failure.
Separately versioned initial-output protocols without rewriting the frozen earlier HOLD.
Evidence-derived metrics without fabricating missing fields.
not_yet_demonstrated: A successful bounded repair conversion from VERIFIED_FAIL to VERIFIED_PASS.
Repeated multi-model or statistically meaningful benchmark performance.
